[size=150][b]Lionheart Fixt 0.8.4 - repairs[/b][/size]

Repair only. One fix, to the fish monger's hidden perk.

0.6.0 gave the Port District's fish monger a secret: sell him enough vodyanoi skulls and he
notices something about how they're built. It could not actually be reached. Haggled sales
were never counted, and once he declared himself full and dropped to ten gold a skull -- which
most players hit around the eighth -- [i]nothing[/i] was counted, because that phase runs through a
different piece of script. Every sale to him now counts, at whatever price.

[b]Fixt[/b] is a cumulative restoration-and-repair mod for Lionheart, after Fallout Fixt.

Download, unzip, run [i]Mod Manager.bat[/i]. Dialogue only, works on any save; skulls sold before
installing stay uncounted.
